sampling: All 600 publisher snapshots in the selected regular-morning interval. Original 2/3/4-second gaps, cent prices, source row ordinals and source sequences retained. No resampling, interpolation, reconstructed quotes or trade volume.
timestampSemantics: publisher Unix-millisecond snapshot timestamp; not independently verified exchange event or first availability time
transformation: Original published top bid/ask doubles encoded on their exact cent grid using their round-trip decimal representation. Original Parquet row ordinals, source sequence and five-level fields retained. No adjustment or price interpolation.

rights.attribution: Source: cooronxon, AShareTickData, primary dataset card MIT, revision cf50faff46a1118524c83b386f32e47d710441f4. Selected original 600900.XSHG L1 snapshots; cent encoding and row ordinals by Market Endgames. Fictional accounts and execution added. No publisher, exchange or vendor endorsement.

limitations: The primary author DATA repository grants MIT for its numerical compilation. Originating feed/vendor rights are not independently certified; no direct exchange permission is claimed.

Original L1 quote provenance is publisher-asserted, not independently crosschecked against an authorised exchange feed. Snapshot timestamps are not guaranteed exchange publication or executable arrival times.
Displayed depth is preserved for provenance but never used as guaranteed liquidity. Fills share a fictional 1000-share snapshot cap after simulated routing.

Only one regular-morning interval is modeled. Inherited shares may sell; shares bought during the chapter cannot be sold before it ends, approximating the single-day consequence of T+1. No next-day release, short sales, auction queues, financing or price-limit liquidity is reconstructed.
Fees and stamp duty are zero game assumptions, not a representation of actual A-share costs. This is an ordinary historical morning, not a claimed black-swan event.
